subject: CloudSprout CPPO onboarding & AWS Marketplace listing questions
messages:
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@cloudsprout.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: CloudSprout — CPPO kickoff & AWS Marketplace listing questions

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this — we want to get CloudSprout set up as a reselling partner for Redwood via an AWS Channel Partner Private Offer (CPPO). We're aiming to have the private offer live in the marketplace by the end of Q3 so CloudSprout can include Redwood in their co-sell bundle.

A few quick questions up front so we can prep on our side:
- Do you have a CPPO intake template you prefer we fill?
- For the listing metadata: who owns the product description and machine-readable SKU mapping?
- Any minimum requirements for reseller contract language (POA/assignment, indemnity)?
- Do you support invoice-split (CloudSprout gets reseller margin on AWS PO) or do you expect a single Redwood invoice routed to CloudSprout?

I attached a short partner profile and our MSP cert so you can see our reseller setup. If helpful we can jump on a 30m call next week to go through the checklist.

Attachments: cloudsprout_partner_info.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), reseller_msp_cert.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Alyssa Grant
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, CloudSprout
alyssa@cloudsprout.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Date: 2027-06-12T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: CloudSprout — CPPO kickoff & AWS Marketplace listing questions

Forwarding Alyssa's note — CloudSprout wants to onboard as a reseller via CPPO and has a target to go live by end of Q3.

Ben / Sergio: can you review the attached partner profile and confirm the following from your side?
- Who will own SKU mapping and canonical product description for the AWS listing (marketing vs. channel ops)?
- Do we need to sign an additional reseller agreement or is the standard partner addendum sufficient?
- Clarify billing expectations: will we support invoice split for CloudSprout (they want margin on the AWS invoice) or will Redwood bill CloudSprout directly?

Vanessa: please flag any billing/legal blockers; if we need a contract redline I think legal will want to see specific language about POA and data retention.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben to create SKU draft and a CPPO request form for CloudSprout.
2) Legal review of partner cert and POA (Vanessa).
3) Quick sync with Alyssa next Tue 6/15 or Wed 6/16 — Kimberly to schedule once we confirm owners.

Thanks — K.P.

--

Thanks Kimberly — quick checklist from channel ops perspective:

Action items I can take on:
- SKU & pricing mapping: I'll draft a SKU-to-Redwood-SKU CSV and suggested list/discount tiers. Expect initial draft by EOD 6/14. (attachment: sku-mapping-draft.csv)
- CPPO intake: we have the redwood_cppo_template.docx we use for PP0 intake; I'll populate with CloudSprout info and attach.
- Partner metadata: marketing owns the human-friendly copy, channel ops owns the machine-readable listing fields. We'll coordinate a single source of truth.

Questions for Vanessa/legal:
- Invoice split: if CloudSprout wants AWS to split and pay a margin directly, we need an approved settlement flow with AWS (Marketplace Reserved Purchase flow). Vanessa, is that supported or do we prefer to invoice CloudSprout post-sale?
- POA: do we require a signed POA from CloudSprout or will their reseller enrollment + MSP cert suffice?

I'm copying a link for the Partner Central account (CloudSprout provided): https://partnercentral.amazon.com/accounts/PA-987654

I'll attach sku-mapping-draft.csv and the template when I send the populated CPPO request.

- For invoice split: CloudSprout prefers AWS-side split so they can recognize margin at the invoice level. If Redwood can support settlement routing via AWS Marketplace, that would be ideal.
- Timeline: CloudSprout is aiming to have the offer visible to joint customers by 2027-09-21 to align with a co-sell campaign.
